200
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully retrieved the list of users for the specified
group.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
Array of objects
An array of user objects.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to list a group's users.
— 404 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management cannot find the specified group.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
